description.value: Pomodoro Pizza is a Port Coquitlam pizzeria specialising in hand-made dough prepared fresh in-house daily. The restaurant offers both pick-up and delivery, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Oxford Street area. Online ordering is available through their website.

address.value: 3-2850 Oxford Street Port Coquitlam, BC V3B 5L7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pomodoropizzas.com is live and confirms this is an active pizza restaurant. However, the OSM record places the business in North Vancouver while the website clearly states the address is 3-2850 Oxford Street, Port Coquitlam, BC — a significant location discrepancy. The OSM coordinates (49.2642682, -122.7663452) are consistent with Port Coquitlam, not North Vancouver, suggesting the community tag is incorrect. The website confirms pickup and delivery ordering but makes no mention of bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or Wi-Fi.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'North Vancouver' but the website address is Port Coquitlam, BC. The OSM coordinates (49.2642682, -122.7663452) are consistent with Port Coquitlam, suggesting the community assignment in OSM is incorrect and should be updated.
OSM record has no address or phone number; both were sourced from the website and could not be cross-confirmed against OSM data.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational pizza restaurant with an active website and online ordering; a straightforward inclusion as a food stop for touring cyclists in the Port Coquitlam area.

wow_evidence: hand-made dough prepared fresh in-house daily
